questions.question: A consumer service is supplied by 4/0 RW90XLPE copper service conductors taken at 75 °C (230 A ampacity). What minimum size copper grounding electrode conductor is required where it runs to a field-assembled (concrete-encased) electrode?
solution_steps: Table 43 keyed to AMPACITY of largest service conductor (not breaker): 4/0 Cu @75 °C = 230 A.
230 A is above 200 A band; the worked CEC value gives size 2. Answer #2 Cu.
questions.question_fa: یک consumer service با service conductorهای 4/0 RW90XLPE مسی که در 75 °C در نظر گرفته می‌شوند (ampacity برابر 230 A) تغذیه می‌شود. حداقل اندازه grounding electrode conductor مسی لازم در جایی که به یک electrode از نوع field-assembled (محصور در بتن) می‌رود چقدر است؟

questions.question: A 150 A service uses 1/0 RW75 copper conductors (150 A ampacity). The grounding electrode conductor runs to a field-assembled electrode. What minimum size copper conductor is required?
solution_steps: Table 43 by service-conductor ampacity: 1/0 Cu @75 °C = 150 A.
150 A is in the lowest band (ampacity ≤165 A → size 4). Answer #4 Cu.
questions.question_fa: یک service با رِیتینگ 150 A از هادی‌های 1/0 RW75 مسی (ampacity برابر 150 A) استفاده می‌کند. grounding electrode conductor به یک field-assembled electrode می‌رود. حداقل اندازه هادی مسی لازم چقدر است؟

questions.question: A 400 A service is supplied with 600 kcmil R90 copper conductors. The grounding conductor connects to a manufactured (rod) electrode. What is the minimum required copper grounding conductor size?
solution_steps: Rule 10-114: to a MANUFACTURED (rod/plate) electrode the grounding conductor need not exceed #6 Cu, regardless of service size.
Cap applies even though Table 43 would give larger. Answer #6 Cu.
questions.question_fa: یک service با رِیتینگ 400 A با هادی‌های 600 kcmil R90 مسی تغذیه می‌شود. grounding conductor به یک manufactured electrode (rod) متصل می‌شود. حداقل اندازه grounding conductor مسی لازم چقدر است؟

questions.question: A feeder is protected by a 100 A overcurrent device. What is the minimum size copper bonding conductor for the raceway, per Table 16?
solution_steps: Bonding conductor sized from OCPD rating via Table 16 (not from conductor ampacity directly).
Table 16: 100 A device → #8 Cu bond. Answer #8 Cu.
questions.question_fa: یک feeder با یک overcurrent device با رِیتینگ 100 A محافظت می‌شود. حداقل اندازه bonding conductor مسی برای raceway طبق Table 16 چقدر است؟

questions.question: A 200 A overcurrent device protects a feeder. What is the minimum size copper bonding conductor required per Table 16?
solution_steps: Bonding = Table 16, keyed to overcurrent device rating ("16 to the BOX").
Table 16: 200 A device → #6 Cu bonding conductor. Answer #6 Cu.
questions.question_fa: یک overcurrent device با رِیتینگ 200 A از یک feeder محافظت می‌کند. حداقل اندازه bonding conductor مسی لازم طبق Table 16 چقدر است؟

questions.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes how grounding (electrode) conductors and bonding conductors are sized in the CEC?
options: A) Both are sized from Table 16 by the breaker rating
B) Grounding electrode conductor = Table 43 (service-conductor ampacity); bonding conductor = Table 16 (overcurrent device rating)
C) Grounding electrode conductor = Table 16; bonding conductor = Table 43
D) Both are sized from Table 2 by the load current
questions.answer: Grounding electrode conductor = Table 43 (service-conductor ampacity); bonding conductor = Table 16 (overcurrent device rating)
solution_steps: Mnemonic: "43 to the EARTH, 16 to the BOX."
Electrode conductor keyed to service-conductor AMPACITY; bonding keyed to OCPD. Answer B.
questions.question_fa: کدام گزاره به‌درستی تفاوت نحوه سایزبندی grounding (electrode) conductorها و bonding conductorها را در CEC بیان می‌کند؟
options_fa: هر دو از روی Table 16 و بر اساس رِیتینگ breaker سایز می‌شوند
grounding electrode conductor = Table 43 (ampacity مربوط به service conductor)؛ bonding conductor = Table 16 (رِیتینگ overcurrent device)
grounding electrode conductor = Table 16؛ bonding conductor = Table 43
هر دو از روی Table 2 و بر اساس جریان بار سایز می‌شوند
questions.answer_fa: grounding electrode conductor = Table 43 (ampacity مربوط به service conductor)؛ bonding conductor = Table 16 (رِیتینگ overcurrent device)

questions.question: In CEC terminology, which best describes the purpose of BONDING (as opposed to grounding)?
options: A) Connecting a current-carrying conductor to the neutral
B) A permanent low-impedance path joining non-current-carrying metal parts together
C) Driving a rod electrode into the earth
D) Limiting the system voltage to ground during normal operation
questions.answer: A permanent low-impedance path joining non-current-carrying metal parts together
solution_steps: Bonding = low-impedance path for non-current-carrying metal so fault current can return and trip the OCPD.
Grounding is the connection of the system/equipment to earth. Answer B.
questions.question_fa: در اصطلاحات CEC، کدام گزینه هدف bonding را (در برابر grounding) بهتر توصیف می‌کند؟
options_fa: اتصال یک هادی حامل جریان به نول
یک مسیر دائمی کم‌امپدانس که قطعات فلزی غیرحامل جریان را به هم متصل می‌کند
کوبیدن یک rod electrode در زمین
محدود کردن ولتاژ سیستم نسبت به زمین در شرایط عادی کار
questions.answer_fa: یک مسیر دائمی کم‌امپدانس که قطعات فلزی غیرحامل جریان را به هم متصل می‌کند

questions.question: Which conductor is the system GROUNDED circuit conductor (the one normally carrying current and identified white or grey), as distinguished from a bonding conductor?
options: C) The identified neutral / grounded circuit conductor
questions.answer: The identified neutral / grounded circuit conductor
solution_steps: The grounded conductor is a normally current-carrying circuit conductor (neutral), identified white/grey.
Bonding/grounding-electrode conductors are non-current-carrying (green/bare). Answer C.
questions.question_fa: کدام هادی، system grounded circuit conductor است (همان هادی‌ای که به‌طور معمول جریان حمل می‌کند و با رنگ سفید یا خاکستری شناسایی می‌شود) و از یک bonding conductor متمایز است؟

questions.question: The minimum equipotential bonding conductor size for a swimming pool per Rule 10-406 is which of the following?
solution_steps: Rule 10-406 equipotential bonding minimum: #6 Cu / #4 Al (Al one size larger).
Answer #6 Cu or #4 Al.
questions.question_fa: حداقل اندازه equipotential bonding conductor برای یک استخر شنا طبق Rule 10-406 کدام‌یک از موارد زیر است؟

questions.question: A field-assembled (concrete-encased) grounding electrode must consist of bare copper conductor not smaller than which size?
solution_steps: Rule 10-102: field-assembled electrode = ≥6 m bare Cu, not smaller than #4 AWG.
Answer #4 AWG.
questions.question_fa: یک field-assembled grounding electrode (محصور در بتن) باید از یک bare copper conductor با اندازه نه کوچک‌تر از کدام مورد تشکیل شود؟

questions.question: Which of the following is a MANUFACTURED grounding electrode rather than a field-assembled one?
options: A) 6 m of bare #4 Cu encased in a concrete footing
C) Reinforcing steel within a foundation footing
D) A bare copper ring buried below grade
solution_steps: Manufactured electrode = factory-made rod or plate (Rule 10-108).
Concrete-encased / ring conductors are field-assembled (Rule 10-102). Answer B.
questions.question_fa: کدام‌یک از موارد زیر یک manufactured grounding electrode است نه یک field-assembled؟
options_fa: 6 m از bare #4 Cu محصور در یک footing بتنی
میلگرد فولادی داخل یک footing شالوده
یک حلقه مسی لخت دفن‌شده زیر تراز زمین

questions.question: Where two manufactured rod electrodes are used to form the grounding electrode, what is the minimum spacing required between them?
solution_steps: Rule 10-104: two or more rod/plate electrodes spaced ≥3 m apart so resistance spheres don't overlap.
Answer 3 m.
questions.question_fa: در جایی که دو manufactured rod electrode برای تشکیل grounding electrode استفاده می‌شوند، حداقل فاصله لازم بین آن‌ها چقدر است؟

questions.question: Per CEC 2024, how may a metal underground water pipe be used in the grounding system?
options: A) As the sole grounding electrode without any supplement
B) It must never be connected to the grounding system
C) Only if it is plastic
D) Only as a supplement to, or bonded in addition to, a recognized grounding electrode
questions.answer: Only as a supplement to, or bonded in addition to, a recognized grounding electrode
solution_steps: Interior metal water piping is bonded, but a water pipe is not accepted as the sole grounding electrode in CEC 2024.
It supplements a recognized electrode (rod/plate/concrete-encased). Answer B.
questions.question_fa: طبق CEC 2024، یک لوله آب فلزی مدفون در زمین چگونه می‌تواند در سیستم grounding استفاده شود؟
options_fa: به‌عنوان تنها grounding electrode بدون هیچ مکمل دیگری
هرگز نباید به سیستم grounding متصل شود
فقط در صورتی که پلاستیکی باشد
فقط به‌عنوان مکمل، یا به‌صورت باندشده در کنار یک grounding electrode معتبر
questions.answer_fa: فقط به‌عنوان مکمل، یا به‌صورت باندشده در کنار یک grounding electrode معتبر

questions.question: At a service with a solidly grounded supply, where is the system grounding (bonding of neutral to enclosure) made?
options: B) At each branch-circuit outlet box
C) At the service box / main switchboard only
D) Nowhere — neutral and ground are never bonded
questions.answer: At the service box / main switchboard only
solution_steps: Neutral-to-enclosure bond (main bonding jumper) is made at the service only; downstream the neutral is isolated from ground.
Bonding everywhere would create parallel neutral paths. Answer B.
questions.question_fa: در یک service با تغذیه solidly grounded، اتصال system grounding (bonding نول به محفظه) در کجا برقرار می‌شود؟
options_fa: در هر جعبه پریز branch circuit
فقط در service box / تابلوی اصلی (main switchboard)
هیچ‌جا — نول و ground هرگز به هم باند نمی‌شوند
questions.answer_fa: فقط در service box / تابلوی اصلی (main switchboard)

questions.question: A branch circuit is protected by a 60 A breaker. Using Table 16, what minimum size copper bonding conductor is required if one is installed in the raceway?
solution_steps: Bonding = Table 16 by OCPD rating. The 60 A breaker (not the conductor) governs.
Table 16: up to 60 A → #10 Cu bond. Answer #10 Cu.
questions.question_fa: یک branch circuit با یک breaker با رِیتینگ 60 A محافظت می‌شود. با استفاده از Table 16، حداقل اندازه bonding conductor مسی لازم در صورت نصب در raceway چقدر است؟
